sloka: एषा नः परमा प्रीतिरेष नः परमो वरः ।हृद्गता नः सदा प्रीतिस्तवानुगमने नृप ।। ७.१०७.१५ ॥
transliteration: eṣā naḥ paramā prītireṣa naḥ paramo varaḥ ।hṛdgatā naḥ sadā prītistavānugamane nṛpa ।। 7.107.15 ॥

translations.english: O King, this is our supreme affection and our greatest wish, for our hearts are always filled with love for following you.
